fields.statement: At 2cfda3de, go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/ship-check-settles-conflict passes: its fake gh reports mergeable CONFLICTING until origin's branch holds main; with a conflict only in .rhiza/rendered, ship check --settled exits non-zero printing 'rebased onto main and pushed', origin/cs/ship-it then contains origin/main, the ship record's pushed equals the new origin head, and a second --settled check exits 0; with a conflict in code.txt it exits 75, prints a stop: line naming code.txt and rebase-conflict, commits only the question, and HEAD~1 and origin/cs/ship-it equal the pre-check head. Reverting internal/api/ship.go to HEAD~1 makes the script fail (line 50, unexpected success).
